name: Watashi wa Title Gamen Desu.
original_name: 私はタイトル画面です。
source:
This is the title screen.
Even though it's the title screen, this mischievous little one won't let you move on to the actual game.
Ther're a chatty one. Please talk to them a lot.
You might experience a strange pseudo-romance.
It's a game that will make you fall for the cute title screen.

However, this game is cursed.
It may contain yandere elements, horror elements, eccentricity, and madness.
